stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: My old drawings are on those sticks.

stations.title: Old sticks
stations.text: Folders in folders, nothing in its place.
stations.note: ls shows one folder at a time.

stations.title: Top folder
stations.text: Three lists of paths, ready to follow.

captions: At Ashgrove, Hesper wants the old drawings back from Sol's copied memory sticks.
The sticks hold folders inside folders, and looking in each one by hand takes forever.
You search every folder by name from the terminal, in three small tasks.
Every drawing, invoice and proofs folder is on a list, with the path to it.
Nothing was moved. Hesper and Idris know where everything on the sticks is.
